prompts.name: hero
prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: transparent landing-page hero cutout for Athos pet shop.
Primary request: a beautiful happy golden retriever sitting upright next to a smaller domestic short-haired brown and gray tabby cat, matching premium pet-store editorial photography.
Subject: dog on the left, cat on the right partially in front of dog's shoulder, both facing camera. Golden retriever mouth gently open, cheerful natural expression, rich golden fur. Alert tabby with green eyes.
Composition/framing: isolated pair with full heads and bodies, lower legs can meet image bottom, tight composition, dog about 1.6 times cat height. Square canvas. No empty space above.
Lighting/mood: soft warm studio lighting, premium, affectionate, finely detailed realistic fur.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background. No background shapes, props, text, collar labels, logos, watermarks or extra animals. This is illustrative stock-style imagery, not a real clinic patient.

prompts.name: cat-cleanup
prompts.prompt: Edit the supplied tabby cat image for the Athos pet shop website. Remove only the golden retriever fur visible along the entire left side and reconstruct the natural outline of this SAME cat, with fine natural fur and whiskers. Preserve the cat's green eyes, facial features, brown/black tabby markings, upright ears, photographic lighting, realistic anatomy and front-facing sitting pose. Deliver a clean photographic chest-up cat cutout on a genuinely transparent background, with fully visible ears and whiskers and a little transparent margin on both sides. No other animals, no background, no shadow rectangle, no text, no logo, no collar, no illustration style. The output will appear on cream and caramel website backgrounds.
